input.summary:
P6 oven court is furnished in parts/room-37.mjs: a flour-sack pile and a barrel with a standing lantern at the west end, and two spruce-trapdoor peel shelves on the oven wall at head height, with the cells in front of the mouth and the north entry kept clear.
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with 6 blocks placed for this part, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines. `$MCD room` says OK with min light 8 and 0 dark cells; `$MCD fit` is OK and `check` reports nothing at x73..77 z13.
The room is a one-row strip, so the design is deliberately sparse; the bread oven's mouth (x75, z14) is the focal point and is outside this box.
left: Unticked: plan.md and elements.md have no checklist item that names the oven court interior (flour sacks, barrel, peel rack are in plan.md's plot 6 facade and Notes only), so nothing was ticked.
`$MCD room` reports one floor cell at y3 (73,3,13, above the lantern) as unreachable; the verdict is still OK and no one can stand there, so it is left as is.
The peel rack's spruce_trapdoor shelves at (74,3,13) and (76,3,13) rely on the oven wall at z14 being built by the shell/chimneys parts; if the wall is missing, the shelves will be unsupported.
The oven's campfire and hay are not in this box; light from the court's lantern does not reach into the oven.

waste.what: Worked out the one-row floor layout by hand, cell by cell, and checked each cell against the doorway rule (nothing in a doorway's first cell) and the light map by re-running the room check after each change.
waste.cost: About 3 room checks and 1 rewrite of the layers() rows; the first draft put sacks and a barrel in the lane cells at x73 and x77, which the doorway rule rejected on reasoning rather than by the tool.
waste.tool: `$MCD room` should name the doorway first cells (the cells a player steps onto from each opening) and flag furniture on them, rather than leaving that to a reading of the plan grid, which marks the whole z12 row as doorway.

waste.what: Checked whether the plan's flour sack and barrel coordinates (73,13) and (77,13) could stay as written; they had to move because (77,13) is the main path cell from the gate.
waste.cost: A few minutes of reasoning, no retries.
waste.tool: A plan.md note saying which cells are entrance paths would make the choice mechanical.

companions.task: Hand over the light plan for the strip: one lantern on the barrel is enough for 8+ everywhere, but a second lamp on the oven wall would show the mouth as the focal point from the path.
Lay the oven apron (y0, z13) and the oven wall at z14 so the peel-shelf trapdoors and the flour sacks sit on finished stone rather than on the ground layer.
